Just a week after stepping down, Jensen Huang hinted he’d be willing to return if the board called. But Nvidia’s leadership has made it clear: they’ve officially ruled out bringing their former CEO back. Nvidia's board has ruled out bringing back former CEO Jensen Huang, despite his statement earlier on Tuesday that he would be willing to return to lead the chipmaking giant after resigning last week. Chairperson Harvey Jones said the board of directors has no intention of reinstating him.
